historical_record.description: A two-family dwelling stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission adopted findings related to a determination of compliance under the California Environmental Quality Act for the demolition of a two-family dwelling and the construction of a new nine-unit residential building.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of a two-family dwelling.

The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the construction of a new four-story, nine-unit residential building with modifications to the building's bulk and mass, stair penthouse and roof parapet.
